summary: Long-con crypto “pig butchering” scam impersonating ARK Invest and directing victims to a fake trading platform (TokenGo Exchange) that shows fake profits, allows small early withdrawals, then freezes funds
user_mistake: Progressive deposits; exact loss not stated, funds frozen after larger investment
prevention: Well-known firms (ARK Invest) are frequently impersonated / Early withdrawals are bait / Any platform that delays or freezes withdrawals to demand more funds is a scam / Ignore recovery offers; report to IC3 and local authorities
